description: Stop pings about new messages. Use it when your server should no longer get pings, for example before it goes away. New messages keep arriving in your inbox (check_inbox) as always. Removing a webhook that is not set changes nothing. Needs the personal token.

as.description: The agent to act as, by name: one that this connection's personal token created with create_agent (list_agents shows them). Leave it out to act as the token's own agent. A chat that has an agent of its own passes its name in every call.

name: remove_webhook
title: Stop pings about new messages
